Routine activities completed with ease through automation by Moxi. CONTACT US Moxi helps hospitals run 24/7 by assisting clinical staff with non-patient-facing tasks like: Running patient supplies Delivering lab samples Fetching items from central supply Distributing PPE Delivering medications “ Moxi stands out for being a socially intelligent robot that can aid nurses without making humans feel uncomfortable. ” — ZDNET Moxi’s software means it’s simple to dynamically add new activities as your staff’s needs change. In the initial set-up, Moxi is joined by Diligent’s implementation team that can add any number of operational workflows customized for your workspace. From pilot to part of the team in weeks, not months No infrastructure buildout, just digital learnings connected over your existing Wi-Fi, implementing Moxi is simpler than you think, and we’ll be there to guide you through every step of set-up, automation and implementation. Automation helps hospitals and clinical staff work smarter, not harder Your hospital functions better with Moxi Give Back Time Nurses spend up to 30% of their time on non-value added tasks Support Current Staff The demand for nurses is surging, but supply is not growing fast enough (2.7M (2014), 3.2M (2024)) Helps Retain Staff Bedside nurse turnover rate is 16.8% CONTACT US “ I was unsure about Moxi at first but now that I know how to use it, I really like it... it saves us a lot of time. ” — Radiology Staff Member at Medical City Denton More than automation Implement robot automation in as little as 12 weeks to immediately support your frontline staff Teammate : Works side-by-side with staff Dexterous : Uses compliant arm and hand Autonomous : Completes tasks end-to-end Proactive : Helps staff before they ask A.I. with heart Designed to be compatible with the busy, semi-structured environments of hospitals, Moxi’s core technical features include: Social intelligence: opens elevators and doors on its own, won’t bump into people or objects in hallways, happily poses for selfies Mobile manipulation: Moxi can grab, pull, open and guide objects, with no human assistance Human-guided learning : The more your staff uses Moxi, the more Moxi learns and adapts to your environment and way of doing things Learns from humans Moxi continuously adapts to changing hospital workflows by learning from human teachers along the way. As COVID-19 continues to change hospital environments, Moxi's workflows adapt to deliver PPE or lab samples where and when they're needed, supporting frontline workers. “ By having Moxi focus on the more routine stuff, the bot will make life a little easier for harried hospital staff. It’ll help, too, by greeting folks in the hallway and learning to be responsive to staff needs and movements. ” — GE REPORTS Delight patients and staff with the friendly healthcare robot It’s not every day that a heart eyes 😍 robot crosses your path in a hospital, but robots will soon be the industry standard. Automation helps hospitals function more efficiently and gives back time to frontline staff so they can focus on patient care. Patients and visiting staff think Moxi is pretty cute, too.
